subject: Payment not received
description: I made a payment 3 days ago but it still shows pending. My money was deducted from my bank account but the order shows unpaid. This is very frustrating.

subject: App crashes on login
description: The mobile app keeps crashing every time I try to login. I have reinstalled it twice but the error persists. Very annoying experience.

subject: Wrong item delivered
description: I ordered a laptop bag but received a phone case instead. The wrong product was shipped to me. Very disappointed with this service.

subject: Refund pending for 20 days
description: My refund has been pending for 20 days now. I returned the product and tracking shows it was delivered. I want my money back immediately.

subject: Cannot track delivery
description: My order was placed 5 days ago and I still cannot find the tracking link. Where is my delivery? I need it urgently.

subject: Account locked out
description: My account got locked after too many login attempts. I forgot my password and now I cannot access my account at all. Please help urgently.

subject: Double charged for subscription
description: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription. This is unacceptable and I demand an immediate refund for the extra charge. I am furious.

subject: Damaged product received
description: The product arrived with a cracked screen. The packaging was terrible and the item is completely broken. Worst experience ever.
